dz: 拉蒙·贝伦盖尔三世,巴塞罗那伯爵,和多斯一世,普罗旺斯伯爵夫人通婚,统一了这两个州的财富.
de: Ramon Berenguer III, Count of Barcelona, and Douce I, Countess of Provence, marry, uniting the fortunes of those two states.
